expected_pass_rate: >= 0.95 (12 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
constraints: H_min=-log2(max p); return bits/sample; no external entropy library is called; empty input raises ValueError; support any hashable type; determinism
source: NIST SP 800-90B; 《密码工程》(Cryptographic Engineering, in Chinese) Ch.12
author: Zhou Wenquan
